description: Single-page modern portfolio website for a Data Science undergraduate and freelance developer, delivered as a single‑file Flask app.
backend_brief: Create a Flask app (variable name `app`) that provides two routes: 1) `GET /` – returns a full HTML page as a single string. The HTML must include the Tailwind CDN, Google Fonts (Inter or Poppins), a `<script>` block that contains all JavaScript, and inline CSS where needed. 2) `POST /contact` – expects JSON with `name`, `email`, and `message`. Validate that all fields are present and non‑empty, that `email` matches a simple regex, and return `{ "status": "success" }` with HTTP 200 if validation passes, otherwise return `{ "status": "error", "error": "<description>" }` with HTTP 400. No file uploads; all responses are JSON. The Flask app should be runnable with `python app.py` and listen on the specified port.
frontend_brief: Build a single‑page application using only vanilla JavaScript, Tailwind CSS via CDN, and Google Fonts. At the top of the script define a `config` object containing placeholders for name, role, tagline, contact info, and URLs so the user can edit them easily. Layout requirements: • Sticky navbar with smooth‑scroll links and active‑section highlighting. • Dark theme with a light/dark toggle persisted in `localStorage`; use a single accent color (e.g., electric violet). • Hero section with a large headline, animated typing effect for the role list, two CTA buttons, particle/gradient background, and social icons (SVG). • About section with a short paragraph and count‑up stats using `requestAnimationFrame`. • Skills section with grouped cards and hover lift effects; use Tailwind utility classes for rounded‑2xl, glassmorphism, and shadows. • Projects section: filter tabs (All/Mobile/Web/AI) that show a grid of cards; each card opens a modal (built with vanilla JS) displaying description, tech stack, role, and link buttons. Include the four sample projects with placeholder images (use CSS gradients or inline SVG). • Services section with service cards and a “Get a quote” button. • Experience/Education vertical timeline with scroll‑reveal animations via `IntersectionObserver`. • Testimonials carousel (auto‑rotate, manual arrows). • Contact section with a form (name, email, message) that validates client‑side, shows a loading spinner, then `fetch` POSTs to `/contact` and displays success/error toasts. Also include direct contact buttons (email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn) using icons. • Footer with copyright, quick links, and a back‑to‑top button. • Add a custom scroll progress bar at the top of the page. • Ensure full responsiveness: mobile‑first layout, hamburger menu for ≤768px, and breakpoints at 360px, 768px, 1280px+. Use semantic HTML5 tags, meta description, Open Graph tags, ARIA labels, and lazy‑load any heavy assets. No external images; use CSS gradients, inline SVGs, or initials‑based avatar placeholders. All interactivity must be implemented with vanilla JS (no libraries).
